expenditures.note: PURPOSE CELL HOLDS TWO LINES. The second reads 'Filing Fee' clearly. The first is an illegible cursive word - at 1200 dpi, contrast-normalized, the legible glyphs are approximately 'Ca...ll' (it begins 'Ca' and ends in a tall double-stroke) and it straddles the header rule. It was NOT completed to a plausible word; the obvious semantic candidate given the payee is not transcribed because the glyphs do not support it. Amount written 235 with a raised superscript 53 over a rule = 235.53, which the page's own SUBTOTAL/TOTAL and Summary line 2 all confirm.

CURRENCY: this filer writes cents as a raised superscript over a short rule throughout (235 with a superscript 53 = 235.53, 10,171 with a superscript 62 = 10,171.62); transcribed with a decimal point per the standing convention. Each of pages 2, 3 and 4 is numbered 'Page 1 of 1' by the filer rather than 2/3/4 of 4 - a per-sheet numbering habit, recorded, not corrected.
